# invoice amount

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:invoiceAmount`](gmeow-invoiceAmount.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/invoiceAmount>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The total monetary amount requested by the invoice, expressed as a [`MonetaryAmount`](../classes/gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md). Functional: an invoice has one canonical total amount.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Invoice`](../classes/gmeow-Invoice.md) -> [`gmeow:MonetaryAmount`](../classes/gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:invoiceAmount`](gmeow-invoiceAmount.md) from [`gmeow:Invoice`](../classes/gmeow-Invoice.md) to [`gmeow:MonetaryAmount`](../classes/gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
